description: This file defines a PHP class 'I18NImportErrorModel' that models internationalization import errors for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses traits and annotations for serialization and API schema documentation, and references an external entity class 'I18NImportError'.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorModel
classes.description: A model class representing internationalization import errors for API communication, implementing normalization and serialization traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the model with an I18NImportError entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
